style: simple grayscale ink-wash approximation: bright paper, gray washes and dark contours

preprocess.pool: low=(sum of 4x4 gray+8)>>4; round grayscale BEFORE pooling

postprocess: nearest-neighbor x4 of final single-channel ink; copy the same byte into R/G/B. No teacher, Sobel, paper texture or lookup-table style filter at deployment
rounding: nearest, ties toward positive infinity; signed arithmetic right shift required
weight_order: OIHW C order, signed two-complement int8; .bin one byte per weight
bias_order: output-channel vector, signed little-endian int32; .hex one 32-bit word per line
activation_order: all golden intermediate maps HWC UINT8; final RGB files explicitly HWC or CHW
padding: zero at first low-res 3x3 conv; last two convs are1x1
normalization: two training BatchNorm layers folded into conv before QAT
temporal: stateless deterministic inference, fixed scales; no per-frame statistics or random texture
onnx_note: fp32 graph is standard floating point; integer_reference.onnx uses FLOAT32-valued INTEGER arithmetic as a golden, not QLinearConv, compiled hardware or a BIT
hardware_compatibility: different from prior C4 and PixelPoster graphs; grayscale1/8/8/1, pool4, UINT8, zero padding and per-layer shifts require accelerator/loader configuration changes
